searchProductHO.select: SELECT A.PROD_CODE AS ProdCode, A.PROD_NAME AS ProdName, B.PROD_VERSION AS CurrentProdVersion, C.PROD_VERSION AS DraftProdVersion, A.END_DT AS EndDt, A.PROD_STAT AS ProdStat, A.PROD_ID AS ProdId, A.DRAFT_PROD_H_ID AS DraftProdHId, A.CURRENT_PROD_H_ID AS prodHId, RTX.TRX_TYPE_CODE AS TrxTypeCode, RS.DESCR AS ProdStatDesc
searchProductHO.from: FROM dbo.PROD A WITH(NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN dbo.PROD_H B WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.CURRENT_PROD_H_ID=B.PROD_H_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.PROD_H C WITH(NOLOCK) ON A.DRAFT_PROD_H_ID=C.PROD_H_ID JOIN dbo.REF_STATUS RS WITH(NOLOCK) ON RS.REF_STATUS_CODE = A.PROD_STAT JOIN dbo.REF_TRX_TYPE RTX WITH(NOLOCK) ON RTX.REF_TRX_TYPE_ID = RS.REF_TRX_TYPE_ID
searchProductHO.where: WHERE RTX.TRX_TYPE_CODE = N'{0}' AND A.PROD_STAT != N'{1}'
